context: Two teens swap fandom and nature trip ideas after school
purpose: Teach: アルミ/インターフェース/恵み/ファイナル/オオカミ/一時期/現物/人びと

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、放課後ヒマ？ファイナルファンタジーの新作、もう買った？
lines.en: Hey, free after school? Did you already buy the new Final Fantasy?
lines.style: Casual high-school girl tone, bright and chatty energy

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 買ったよ。週末ずっとやってた。一時期ハマってた古いシリーズより全然いいかも。
lines.en: Bought it. Played all weekend. Might be better than that old series I was into for a while.
lines.style: Relaxed teenage boy, slightly nerdy and enthusiastic delivery

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかる！特にインターフェースがめっちゃ使いやすくなったよね、操作サクサクで。
lines.en: Right! Especially the interface got way easier to use, controls are super smooth.
lines.style: Excited agreement, fast-paced teen girl speaking style

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そうそう。あ、そういえば来週、山にキャンプ行かない？自然の恵みっていうか、空気うますぎるらしいよ。
lines.en: Yeah, exactly. Oh, by the way, wanna go camping in the mountains next week? Nature's bounty, kinda — the air is supposed to be amazing.
lines.style: Casual teen boy suggesting plans, friendly and inviting tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いいね！でもあの辺、野生のオオカミが出るって聞いたんだけど、大丈夫かな…？
lines.en: Sounds great! But I heard wild wolves show up around there, will we be okay?
lines.style: Slightly worried teen girl, voice trailing off nervously at end

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 大丈夫だって。地元の人びとも普通にハイキングしてるし、音の出るアルミ缶を鞄に付けとけば寄ってこないよ。
lines.en: It's fine. The local people hike there normally, and if you clip a noisy aluminum can to your bag, they won't come near.
lines.style: Reassuring teen boy, knowledgeable and slightly cocky delivery

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ決まり！テントとか、ネットの写真じゃ不安だから現物見たくて、明日お店寄ろうよ。
lines.en: Then it's settled! I'm nervous about just online photos for tents, I wanna see the real thing, so let's hit the store tomorrow.
lines.style: Decisive teen girl wrapping up plans, cheerful and practical tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 了解。じゃあ駅前の店で五時集合な。ゲームの話の続きもそこでしよう。
lines.en: Got it. Five o'clock at the shop near the station then. We can continue the game talk there.
lines.style: Casual confirmation, easygoing teen boy finishing the conversation
